_comment: banker.json - what Oswin Coinwright, the Lumora banker (Scripts/banker_npc.gd on a talking_vendor.tscn), says. Same shape as the scribes' files: greeting (when the bank opens), ambient/secret (said to anyone nearby every few minutes; secret only at night), topics (keywords said near him). A topic whose 'then' has hail: true opens the bank.
greeting: Your vault, as you left it. I count everything twice.
Deposits on the left, withdrawals on the right. Mind the ink.
Welcome back. Nothing has gone missing. Nothing ever goes missing here.
ambient: Safe storage! Your goods kept dry, counted and guarded.
A traveler's pack is a fine thing until it is full. Then it is a burden.
Every copper counted, every crate sealed. Lumora's vault never sleeps.
secret: The vault is older than the wall, you know. Some of the boxes down there have no owners left to claim them.
Between us, the Wardens bank here too. They pay extra for the bottom shelf.

lines: Of course. Let me fetch your box.
